The floor manager on pet comfort
This section explains what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section sets the standard for daily handling of animal travel cases at Aurelia Skyways and keeps every passenger interaction calm, accurate, and ready for boarding. The desk must give clear guidance before departure, confirm that each traveler understands the carrier and document requirements, and keep the welcome team aligned so boarding begins without confusion. Every case is a shared responsibility, and the desk must treat it that way from first contact to handoff.

Staff must review each request carefully and speak in plain language. If the traveler arrives with incomplete papers, the desk must stop the process, identify the missing item, and direct the traveler to the proper next step without delay. If a pet shows signs of distress, the desk must alert the welcome team at once and keep the interaction steady, brief, and respectful. Never promise acceptance until the file is complete and the pet is ready for transfer.

The desk must keep records neat, current, and easy to follow. Any change in route, carrier status, or handling note must be entered at once so the next employee can act on reliable information. When a traveler needs added support, the desk should remain available, avoid rushed answers, and keep the focus on safe movement and clear instruction. Do not let a busy lobby weaken the standard of care.

At boarding, the desk must verify that the animal and traveler match the approved record, then pass the case to the welcome team in an orderly way. Speak clearly, avoid casual assumptions, and make sure the traveler leaves with no uncertainty about the next step. If an issue appears after handoff, the desk must respond immediately and follow the service chain without argument. The service treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and that expectation applies at every desk contact.

For any unresolved concern, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
